title: docs: pages.mdx still says a kind 'full' page with its own tab bar is "drawn as authored" everywhere; it applies on the desktop full page only
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · asked for by L1-b on PR #36273 (ACCEPT 7074362744). This is the same "drawn as authored everywhere" reading that #36211 fixes in the spec migration text. It is a separate card, as L1 asked.

## What happens
`content/docs/ui/pages.mdx:235` says a page that needs its own tab bar is `kind: 'full'` and is "drawn as authored". Under #36197 that holds on the desktop full page only. On a phone and in the side preview, the standard record page is drawn. A reader expects the authored page everywhere.

## Done when
The sentence carries #36197's limit: drawn as authored on the desktop full page; the phone and the side preview draw the standard page. Use the same wording as #36211's fix. No other change.

reach: docs readers; read from the file.
Business reason: authors design a full page and are surprised when phones show the standard one.
Reader: docs (content/docs/ui).
Dedupe: `pages.mdx "drawn as authored"` → only #36211.
Grade: p3.
